adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly triggers a full member-list refetch after each membership mutation: in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both `addMembers()` and `removeMember()` call `self.findMembers()` in their success callbacks. `findMembers()` hits `/groups/:name/members.json` and the server endpoint `GroupsController#members` computes `total = group.users.count`, so every refetch includes a COUNT(*) query. This is a performance/architecture concern (N mutations cause N refetches + counts), not a correctness defect.
